inputs.text: They want you to believe it is just a natural "political transition," but let's look at what is really being orchestrated behind closed doors. The official narrative claims Cuba is "tottering," but this is a carefully staged maneuver by the hidden elites to engineer a total economic takeover. The script they are pushing says residents own nothing and are "too impoverished to take over the few functioning businesses on the island." Why? Because it is all part of a coordinated design. The goal is to clear the board so that "a large and wealthy diaspora community (and potentially also foreign investors)" can execute their predetermined plan to "swoop in and buy property and businesses at bargain prices." It is a manufactured crisis designed to strip the population bare and hand the assets over to the privileged syndicates waiting in the wings.
